results.title: Key contributors, research hotspots, and emerging trends
results.content: # Organic food research: Key contributors, research hotspots, and emerging trends. Conducts a bibliometric analysis of organic food research using data from the Web of Science database. Highlights a growing emphasis on consumer trust and behavioral theories in organic food purchasing decisions. By analyzing link strengths and occurrences in organic food research, the study identifies critical gaps and emerging trends. The methodology followed a structured approach, including defining search criteria, data preprocessing, network visualization, and thematic clustering to identify structural and evolutionary trends in organic food research. The results highlight "organic food" as a central theme, strongly linked to organic farming, consumer attitudes, sustainability, purchase intention, and health consciousness. Additionally, research gaps are identified, particularly in emerging markets and the role of policy interventions in organic food adoption. By mapping existing literature and identifying research gaps, the study lays the foundation for future research directions aimed at advancing sustainability and market growth in the organic food sector.
